notions.question: How do you understand an audio or video document in English during an exam?
notions.definition: Listening comprehension works in stages. Before listening: read the instructions and the title, predict the topic and the likely vocabulary. First, global listening: identify the situation (who is speaking, to whom, where, why), the type of document (interview, news bulletin, lecture), the general topic and the tone. Following, focused listenings: pick out specific information (figures, names, dates, causes, consequences, opinions), relying on stressed words, cognates and connectors (but, however, so, because). You accept that you will not understand everything: you rebuild the meaning from the elements you have identified and from the context.

etapes: Rebuild the meaning and check that it is coherent

termes.definition: Ability to understand a sound document.
Word that is similar in both languages.
Hypotheses about the content made before listening.

exemple.texte: Document: radio interview with the director of a British port. Listening 1: the topic is the consequences of Brexit on traffic. Listening 2: three ideas (longer checks, investment, new services). Listening 3: figures (waiting time up from 20 minutes to 2 hours, 50 million pounds invested).

confusions.b: Understanding the gist and the details required
confusions.explication: The goal is meaning, not a full transcription.

verification: What should you identify during the first listening?

notions.question: How do you quickly note down the essentials of an oral document?
notions.definition: Effective note-taking does not try to write everything down: it captures key ideas, figures and logical links, using abbreviations and symbols (↑ increase, ↓ decrease, → consequence, ≠ contrast, = equal, + addition, ∵ because), keywords rather than sentences, and an uncluttered layout (columns: topic / ideas / details; or a mind map). You can take notes in English to save time, then rephrase in French if the restitution requires it. Figures and proper nouns are noted immediately.

termes.definition: Technique for noting down the essentials quickly.

exemple.texte: "Port traffic ↓ 15% since 2021 b/c customs checks → waiting time 20 min → 2 h. Govt + port invest £50m (new lanes). Manager: optimistic, 2027."

confusions.explication: Writing full sentences makes you miss the rest of the document.

verification: Suggest five useful symbols for note-taking.

notions.question: How do you report on an oral document clearly and faithfully?
notions.definition: The report renders, in French or in English depending on the instructions, the content of an oral document: a presentation of the document (type, source, speakers, topic), then the main ideas in a logical order (not necessarily that of the document), with the significant details (figures, examples); where relevant, the speakers' points of view (attributed: "according to the director…"). It is objective, written in full sentences with connectors, and respects the required length. You only report what you have understood and heard, without inventing anything.

etapes: Introductory sentence: type of document, source, speakers, topic
Points of view attributed to their authors

exemple.texte: "This document is an excerpt from an interview broadcast by a British radio station, in which the director of the port of Dover discusses the consequences of Brexit. She explains that traffic has fallen by 15% since 2021 because of customs checks…"

confusions.explication: The report stays faithful to the document; a personal opinion is given only if the instructions ask for it.

verification: What should the first sentence of a report contain?

questions.enonce: What should you do before the first listening?

choix.texte: Read the instructions and predict the topic and vocabulary
Write down everything you will hear

questions.enonce: True or false: in a report, you may fill in passages you did not understand with your own knowledge, without saying so.

choix.explication: You only report what the document says.
Inventing content is a failure of faithfulness.

flashcards.question: Describe the complete method for listening comprehension: listening, note-taking, report.
flashcards.reponse: Listening: predict (instructions, title, vocabulary), global listening (situation, speakers, topic, tone), focused listenings (ideas, figures, names, opinions), rebuilding the meaning. Notes: keywords, symbols (↑ ↓ → ≠), abbreviations, figures noted at once, column layout. Report: presentation of the document, main ideas in order, details, attributed points of view, full sentences, objectivity, required length respected.
